name: hydroelectric_head_power
title: Hydroelectric plant: power from flow rate, head and turbine efficiency (exercise)
summary: Energy balance of a hydroelectric turbine with a volume flow rate of 100 m³/s, a head of 120 m, a turbine efficiency of 0.8 and a density of 1000 kg/m³. The model computes the mass flow rate, the turbine power and the loss rate. Teaching exercise Cengel 2-123.
